capturedFrom.sourceRef: local worker session tee; absolute path and session id withheld

transforms.seq: reassigned densely 1..N in kept order; synthetic user seed is seq 1
transforms.ts: anchor 1704067200000 + (original ts - first source ts); user seed = anchor - 1
transforms.ids: 145 tool ids and 107 message ids remapped in first-seen order; equality relationships preserved
transforms.strings: 1801 distinct non-whitespace strings replaced with [redacted #n]; whitespace-only -> single space
transforms.urls: 0 distinct URL-like values replaced with redacted-url-N
transforms.titles: tool titles replaced with kind label (Execute/Read/Edit/Search/Tool)
transforms.contents: content block shape preserved; text/delta/output bodies replaced

synthetic.reason: tee files carry agent session/update notifications but not the user prompt; this single seed exercises the replay user-echo branch before agent activity

removed: file paths, repo names and usernames
limitations: structural JSON keys are preserved; a secret embedded in an unusual key name would not be scrubbed
whitespace-only chunks are canonicalized to one space, so exact spacing is not preserved
absolute run time is replaced by a fixed anchor; timestamps preserve relative gaps only
only ACP session/update kinds and turn/complete are kept; rpc/config/usage/process noise is dropped
text equality is preserved as equality classes (identical originals share a marker); individual characters are not
the user seed is synthetic because tee files do not record user prompts
